name: The large sieve: harmonic analysis in analytic number theory
summary: Duality for trigonometric polynomials gives inequalities on sums over characters, producing the Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem on primes in arithmetic progressions.

name: Ito calculus and stochastic differential equations
summary: A differential and integral calculus for Brownian paths is built and used to solve stochastic differential equations.

name: Finite element method
summary: Piecewise polynomial trial spaces gave systematic solvers.

name: Recursion theory and realizability
summary: Recursive functions were used to interpret intuitionistic arithmetic.

name: Distributions
summary: Generalised functions were defined as continuous linear functionals on test functions, unifying Dirac delta, weak derivatives and Fourier transforms.

name: Chern: intrinsic Gauss-Bonnet and characteristic classes
Homological algebra
summary: Chain complexes, derived functors and exact sequences, first tools of algebraic topology, are turned into a general machinery for modules and then for sheaves.

name: Axiomatic homology
summary: Homology theories were characterised by axioms such as excision, allowing comparison and later generalised theories.

name: Shannon: communication theory of secrecy
summary: Information-theoretic concepts were used to define and bound secrecy of ciphers.

name: Landau damping: plasma physics to nonlinear PDE
summary: A prediction of plasma physics from 1946 is proved for the nonlinear Vlasov equation in Gevrey regularity, using analytic norms and a new treatment of echoes.
